svg.title: PhenoGraph: marker measurements, neighbour weights and Leiden groups
svg.desc: Selected per-cell marker measurements are centred by their full-population medians, divided by interquartile ranges with a unit fallback and multiplied by their configured feature weights. The application supplies training-set Euclidean neighbours with each cell excluded by identity to Python PhenoGraph’s Jaccard graph and Leiden functions. The illustrative k equals two example has N(i)={j,a} and N(j)={i,a}, so their Jaccard similarity is one third. Symmetrizing selected directed candidate weights preserves J for reciprocal pairs and yields J/2 for a one-way pair. Positive undirected edges supply weighted Leiden partitioning and neutral keyed cluster names. Optional UMAP separately uses a stratified display sample with the full-population feature scaling; cluster names contribute sampling strata and display colours. The nearest-neighbour example uses explicit illustrative coordinates, the weighted graph uses the retained nine-cell calculation, and the UMAP drawing is schematic. None is an observed biological result.
svg.text: sⱼ = Q₃ − Q₁; use 1 if zero
